issues.issue: Printed Chapter CII / sequential editorial CIII occupies original first-edition PDF558/printed524; following printed CIII starts on PDF559/printed525. Do not merge.
Accident-based rectification is called most certain by Lilly, but this is an authorial comparative claim rather than independent evidence of accurate birth-time recovery.
Prerequisite planetary and Part of Fortune strengths, debilities and chart positions rely on source tables and rectified natal inputs not independently astronomically verified here.
The words 'natural influences' refer to Lilly's historical astrological system, not scientifically established physical effects.
Selecting event category Life, Preferment, Marriage, Estate or Travell may change significator and promissor; candidate selection flexibility must be specified in a prospective test.
Condition/strength and mutual aspects can retroactively excuse a predicted outcome, requiring preregistered interpretation before looking at participants.
Antiscia and contra-antiscia increase candidate matches beyond standard planetary longitudes; exact reflection and orbs are not specified in this chapter.
The proximity to both house cusps and other planets has no numerical orb supplied on PDF558; the original wording cannot be silently translated into a fixed modern threshold.
Fixed stars are described as first/second magnitude, small ecliptic latitude; 'small' is not quantified and original stars are not individually identified here.
Modern magnitude, equatorial coordinates, precession and ecliptic-latitude models must not be substituted without source parity and epoch disclosure.
Lilly describes the stars as increasing significator vigor if of the same 'nature'; this is a symbolic classification, not an independent measured effect.
The chapter contains no case-specific prediction, observed clinical result, birth-time correction record, or falsifiable output for a named natal chart.
The next chapter's claims about a child's infancy and lifespan are separate and high-stakes historical beliefs; do not treat as medical advice or an actual prognosis.
The source is one compact paragraph on printed p524 and its individual extracted conditions are annotations, not independently validated predictive rules.
The original full 1647 scanned PDF remains the source of authority; the JPEG page witness is preserved by SHA-256 and size.
No complete independent secondary diplomatic transcription is claimed.
No new chart parity, independent person-level predictive validation or runtime rule promotion follows from this extraction.
